identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Grid with Terminal Aesthetics.
Content is King: Data density is a feature, not a bug.
Contrast: High contrast for code readability; subtle contrast for hierarchy.
No Gradients: Use solid colors and 1px borders. Gradients are for marketing, not engineering.

usage.code: font-mono text-sm bg-muted/50 p-1 rounded-sm text-primary

modes.marketing: Asymmetric 'Tetris' Grid. Use col-span-8 for hero, col-span-4 for details.
modes.dashboard: Dense 'Bento' Grid. 100% width utilization. No jagged bottoms.

buttons.primary: rounded-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-xs h-10 px-6 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(183,65,14,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(183,65,14,0.5)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: rounded-sm font-mono border border-border hover:bg-muted/50 hover:text-foreground transition-colors

cards.style: bg-card border border-border/50 rounded-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.style: bg-muted/20 border-border/50 font-mono text-sm focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-sm h-11

navigation.style: border-b border-border/40 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border/40. Use 'border-r' on grid items to create a technical table look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None or very subtle ambient glow for active states only.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle 'scanline' or 'noise' overlay on the background to give it a hardware feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Force Dark Mode by default. The app should feel like a sophisticated IDE.
3. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento' grid for the Hardware Selection Dashboard. It must look dense and data-rich.
4. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components to have sharp edges (rounded-sm) and thinner borders.
5. COLOR: Use the Rust Orange (#B7410E) sparingly for primary actions (Generate, Download, Deploy). Do not overuse it.
6. DATA: When displaying hardware specs, use a monospace font in a table layout with visible grid lines.
7. MICRO-INTERACTIONS: Add hover states to every interactive element. Buttons should glow slightly on hover.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (WCAG AA).
Mobile responsiveness is mandatory. Stack grids on mobile.
